items.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: So when I went to the audition that night, the guy who was the band leader was this guy who used to come buy the fishing equipment from me.

ctx.x: The drummer? He and I grew up like brothers. I mean I was the best man in his wedding. And he came in Sears one day and he says, “Hey what are you doing working here, man?” I said, “Well it’s part of my college course and I have to do it.” He says, “Look I’m working a job on Bourbon Street as a trumpet player, but I want the job as the drummer.” He said, “Why don’t you come take this job as the trumpet player?” And I was like, “You play drums?” I didn’t even know he played drums then. He was like, “Yeah.” I said,…
